title: Jadawalin gaskiya, rahotanni masu gaskiya da dashboard mai shafi ɗaya

say: Jadawalin gaskiya, rahotanni na gaskiya, da dashboard mai shafi ɗaya.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don tsari na 3 na Rahoto da Bibiyar Ayyuka.
Kyakkyawan ginshiƙi yana ƙyale mai karatu mai aiki ya ga babban batu a cikin 'yan daƙiƙa kaɗan. Don nuna canji akan lokaci, yi amfani da ginshiƙi na layi.

panel.heading: Daidaita ginshiƙi da saƙon

cards.d: Yadda lamba ta canza akan lokaci, kamar tallace-tallace na wata-wata daga Janairu zuwa Yuni.
Wane nau'i ne ya fi girma, kamar tallace-tallace ta tashar: WhatsApp, Walk-in, Instagram.
Yadda gabaki ɗaya ke rarrabuwa zuwa sassa, kawai tare da yanka 2 zuwa 5. Kada a taɓa canzawa akan lokaci.

say: Dashboard allo ɗaya ne wanda ke nuna 3 zuwa 5 KPI akan maƙasudan su. Haɗa kowane tantanin halitta tare da dabara, kar a taɓa buga lambobi a ciki, don haka yana ɗaukaka kansa. Sa'an nan kuma ƙara koren, amber da jajayen launi tare da tsara yanayin.

panel.heading: Dashboard na Maris na Bisi

say: Misali, siyar da Bisi ta watan Maris Naira 280,000 ne sabanin 300,000. Wannan shine 93%, don haka yana nuna amber.

panel.heading: Dashboard na Maris na Bisi

say: Oda 64 akan 60, kuma juyi shine 26% akan 25%. Duk kore.

panel.heading: Dashboard na Maris na Bisi

say: Amma maimaita abokan ciniki shine 31% akan 40%, kawai 78%. Ja.

Don haka aikinta na gaba shine kiyaye abokan ciniki, ba talla ba. Kyakkyawan dashboard yana nuna shawara na gaba. Ci gaba da ganin kashi kuma, saboda wasu masu karatu ba za su iya tantance ja daga kore ba.

panel.heading: Dashboard na Maris na Bisi

say: Don tunawa. Zaɓi ginshiƙi wanda ya dace da saƙon, fara sanduna a sifili, kuma bari taken ya faɗi batun.
Ba da ƙididdiga da dalilai a hankali. Bayar da rahoton abubuwan da aka rasa a gaskiya, tare da dalili da tsari. Kuma ajiye dashboard ɗin ku zuwa ƴan KPI masu alaƙa.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Layi don abubuwan da ke faruwa, sanduna don kwatanta, tebur don daidai

Dashboard: 3 zuwa 5 masu alaƙa da KPI tare da launuka

say: Yanzu yi aiki. Yi ginshiƙi na gaskiya guda ɗaya tare da take wanda ke bayyana binciken. Bincika rahoto game da binciken gaskiya mai maki biyar, kuma saita takardar ku zuwa Ƙuntatacce. Sannan gina dashboard ɗin ku tare da launuka masu haske na zirga-zirga da yanayin yanayi ɗaya.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
